notes.text: Storyteller dice trays were spawning in Scatter Mode tilted; they should always have x- and z-rotations of zero, only the y-rotation of the dice trays should change

I've decided that players should keep their table slots throughout a single session -- i.e. the randomization of slots should only ever occur at the start of the session (Intermission to Play), and persist until the next transition from Intermission to Play.
In Scatter Mode, Storyteller dice trays weren't being hidden when the roll was cleared from the dashboard.
When a player changes their group in scatter mode, it isn't updated on the Dashboard.

When the game transitions to a Scatter Mode scene and there are seated NPCs at the table, those NPCs should not count as occupying the "PC side" of a scatter group: The five PCs should always be spread out, one to a group, at the start of a Scatter Mode scene. All NPCs that occupy seated positions in scatter mode should automatically move to the NPC side of the stage, into NPC slots around the scatter groups.

The scatter mode groups, and the positions PC's and NPCs occupy in those groups, should appear and be configurable in the preview panel (including when a Table scene is switched to scatter mode in the preview panel)

Right-clicking a scene in the scene deck should open up the edit panel immediately. 

To _end_ a scene, I want the interaction to be click and hold. While the left button is held down, the scene rectangle should fill with red from left to right and, when it is filled, it should be ended.

Let's split the scene deck and phase/scene title and control buttons into two rows.  The top row should include the phases, the scene name (if any) and the Scene and advance phase buttons; the second row beneath it should be the scene deck, and include all of the on-deck scenes, centered.
Compulsion cards aren't being read from TTS on a reload of the Dashboard
Remove the close button; double-clicking a collapsed panel should clear the roll

With many scenes on deck at once, the advance button got pushed off the right side of the screen.  The change to showing the scene panel as a double-row should fix this, but if so many scenes are on deck that even that would cause overflow, flex-shrink the scene bars so they can all be shown, with each one growing to its full width when it is hovered over

For the add-project modal, the fields required for the next step of setting up the project should be highlighted with a glow.  As soon as enough information is provided for the launch roll, the Roll button should light up.

After clicking the Roll button, the roll showed up in the Storyteller Dashboard Scene roll panel with the difficulty set, but it was not automatically opened for the player -- I had to deselect and reselect the difficulty for it to work.
Player compulsion cards are not moving with the rest of their objects in Scatter mode
The particle emitter isn't working in Scatter Mode (switching to a table mode fixes it though)
Several of the generated tokens seem to be missing most of their names:  "Laz"  reads "L", "Benedict Kincaid" reads "B", "Severin Koslov" has only a corrupted "S", there may be others
Tokens are being spawned at the bottom right corner of the stage board, moving to the left and then up.  They should spawn at the top left corner, moving right and then down
